title: Second moment of a prescribed Fourier kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $a\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The uniform expectation over $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ of the square of the prescribed Fourier kernel associated with $\mathcal{F}$ and $a$ is $1/|\mathcal{F}|$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal{F}$ is a finite nonempty family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
